def require(value,message):
    if not value: raise AssertionError(message)
def digest(path):
    p=Path(path);h=hashlib.sha256()
    with p.open('rb') as f:
        for block in iter(lambda:f.read(1024*1024),b''):h.update(block)
    return h.hexdigest()
def auth(path,sha):
    p=str(Path(path).resolve());counters['hash_references']+=1
    if p not in unique_hashes:unique_hashes[p]=digest(p)
    require(unique_hashes[p]==sha,'SHA mismatch '+p)
def read(path):return pd.read_csv(path,float_precision='round_trip')
def compare(name,left,right,*,exact=True):
    a=np.asarray(left);b=np.asarray(right)
    require(a.shape==b.shape,f'{name} shape {a.shape} {b.shape}')
    if a.dtype.kind in 'biuf' and b.dtype.kind in 'biuf':
        ok=np.isclose(a.astype(float),b.astype(float),rtol=0 if exact else 1e-12,atol=0 if exact else 1e-12,equal_nan=True)
    else:
        aa=pd.Series(a).fillna('').astype(str).to_numpy();bb=pd.Series(b).fillna('').astype(str).to_numpy()
        ok=aa==bb
    if not np.all(ok):
        ix=np.flatnonzero(~ok)[:5]
        raise AssertionError(f'{name} values mismatch at {ix.tolist()}: {a[ix]} != {b[ix]}')
    counters['compared_cells']+=a.size
def oracle(frame):
    # Independent literal state machine; no detector/feature builder imported.
    n=len(frame); idx=frame.index
    x={k:frame[k].to_numpy() for k in ('open','high','low','close','volume','tr','atr','s20','e20','md','sb','middle','ropeHigh','width','flips','pastWidth','pastCrosses','ready')}
    gaps=np.r_[False,np.diff(idx.asi8)!=H.value]
    segment_start=np.maximum.accumulate(np.where(gaps,np.arange(n),0))
    complete=np.arange(n)-segment_start>=12
    raw_finite=np.isfinite(frame[['width','flips']].to_numpy(float)).all(axis=1)
    summary_finite=np.isfinite(frame[['pastWidth','pastCrosses']].to_numpy(float)).all(axis=1)
    bad_prefix=np.r_[0,np.cumsum(~raw_finite)]
    support_finite=complete & (bad_prefix[np.arange(n)]-bad_prefix[np.maximum(0,np.arange(n)-12)]==0)
    valid=complete&support_finite&summary_finite&frame.ready.eq(True).to_numpy()
    base_dense=complete&frame.ready.eq(True).to_numpy()&(x['pastWidth']<=3)&(x['pastCrosses']>=2)
    dense=valid&base_dense
    priorhi=np.full(n,np.nan);priorlo=np.full(n,np.nan)
    recent=np.zeros(n,bool);advance=np.full(n,np.nan);ratio=np.full(n,np.nan)
    for start,end in zip(np.r_[0,np.flatnonzero(gaps)],np.r_[np.flatnonzero(gaps),n]):
        p=frame.iloc[start:end]
        priorhi[start:end]=p.high.shift().rolling(12,min_periods=12).max()
        priorlo[start:end]=p.low.shift().rolling(12,min_periods=12).min()
        recent[start:end]=pd.Series(base_dense[start:end]).shift().rolling(12,min_periods=12).sum().gt(0).to_numpy()
        pastatr=p.atr.shift(3);advance[start:end]=((p.close-p.close.shift(3))/pastatr).where(pastatr.gt(0))
        hv=p.volume.shift(3)
        median=hv.dropna().rolling(20,min_periods=20).median().reindex(p.index).ffill()
        ratio[start:end]=(p.volume.rolling(3,min_periods=3).sum()/(3*median)).where(median.gt(0))
    fast=np.maximum(x['s20'],x['e20'])
    condition=frame.ready.eq(True).to_numpy()&(x['close']>priorhi)&(x['close']>fast)
    rising=np.r_[False,x['middle'][1:]>x['middle'][:-1]]&~gaps
    mdok=x['md']>=x['sb']
    quality=frame.ready.eq(True).to_numpy()&recent&(advance>=1.5)&(ratio>=1.5)&mdok&rising
    checks=dict(prog_dense=base_dense,prog_prior_high=priorhi,prog_prior_low=priorlo,prog_recent_dense=recent,
        prog_advance=advance,prog_volume_ratio=ratio,fast_high=fast,early_condition=condition,
        tag_recent_density=recent,tag_md_ge_signal=mdok,tag_middle_rising=rising,tag_advance=advance>=1.5,tag_volume=ratio>=1.5)
    records=[]
    last=-1;owner=-1;parent=-1;child_sent=False;prev=False;armed=True;quota_origin='bootstrap'
    owner_high=owner_low=parent_high=np.nan;owner_origin='';sid=0;false_seen=False;false_i=-1
    rearm_at=rearm_owner=rearm_false=-1;rearm_high=rearm_low=np.nan
    for i in range(n):
        if gaps[i]:
            last=owner=parent=-1;child_sent=prev=False;armed=True;quota_origin='bootstrap'
            owner_high=owner_low=parent_high=np.nan;owner_origin='';false_seen=False;false_i=-1
            rearm_at=rearm_owner=rearm_false=-1;rearm_high=rearm_low=np.nan
        oldowner=owner; before=armed;disjoint=owner>=0 and i-12>owner;rearm=False
        if owner>=0 and not armed:
            if valid[i] and not dense[i]:
                if not false_seen:false_i=i
                false_seen=True
            if false_seen and dense[i] and disjoint:
                armed=True;quota_origin='density_rearm';rearm=True
                rearm_at=i;rearm_owner=owner;rearm_false=false_i;rearm_high=priorhi[i];rearm_low=priorlo[i]
        available=armed;edge=bool(condition[i] and not prev);cool=(last<0 or i-last>=12)
        early=edge and cool and available;blocked=edge and cool and not available;reason=''
        if edge and not early:
            reason='cooldown' if not cool else 'density_unknown' if not valid[i] else 'await_density_false' if not false_seen else 'await_density_reentry' if not dense[i] else 'await_disjoint_support'
        origin=quota_origin if early else ''
        if early:
            last=owner=parent=i;parent_high=owner_high=priorhi[i];owner_low=priorlo[i];owner_origin=quota_origin
            child_sent=armed=false_seen=False;false_i=-1;sid+=1
        if parent>=0 and i-parent>3:parent=-1;parent_high=np.nan;child_sent=False
        child=bool(parent>=0 and not child_sent and quality[i] and x['close'][i]>parent_high)
        if child:child_sent=True
        N=lambda a:np.nan if a<0 else float(a)
        records.append(dict(early=early,confirmed=child,parent_i=N(parent),frozen_parent_high=parent_high,
            confirm_age=float(i-parent) if child else np.nan,candidate_edge=edge,cooldown_blocked=edge and not cool,
            structure_blocked=blocked,reject_reason=reason,gap_reset=bool(gaps[i]),quota_armed_before=before,
            quota_armed_for_edge=available,quota_armed=armed,bootstrap_quota=armed and quota_origin=='bootstrap',
            accept_origin=origin,bootstrap_accepted=early and origin=='bootstrap',structure_id=float(sid) if owner>=0 else np.nan,
            structure_owner_i=N(owner),structure_owner_before_i=N(oldowner),structure_bootstrap=owner>=0 and owner_origin=='bootstrap',
            structure_high=owner_high,structure_low=owner_low,density_false_seen=false_seen,first_false_i=N(false_i),
            support_disjoint=disjoint,rearmed=rearm,rearm_i=N(rearm_at),rearm_owner_i=N(rearm_owner),rearm_false_i=N(rearm_false),
            rearm_window_start_i=float(rearm_at-12) if rearm_at>=0 else np.nan,

            rearm_window_high=rearm_high,rearm_window_low=rearm_low,

        prev=bool(condition[i])
    state=pd.DataFrame(records)
    density=dict(density_valid=valid,density_is_dense=dense,density_known_false=valid&~dense,
        density_support_complete=complete,density_support_finite=support_finite,density_summaries_finite=summary_finite,
        density_window_start_i=np.where(complete,np.arange(n)-12,np.nan),density_window_end_i=np.where(complete,np.arange(n)-1,np.nan))
    for k,v in density.items():state[k]=v
    counters['prior12_support_row_checks']+=int(complete.sum())*12
    counters['gap_rows']+=int(gaps.sum())
